3.speaker: Player
3.text: “We need to find out who has ulterior motives and root them out of the administration.”

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: Karl Greiser arrived for a meeting to discuss the new police force. After Livia informed us of his arrival, Lucian opened the door and let him in.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Karl and Lucian left the room.

7.speaker: Player
7.text: “I guess Minister Morgna is on our side on this. She really wants to tackle corruption inside.”

8.speaker: Player
8.text: “Keep pursuing this Karl. If you encounter any obstacles, my full authority will protect you.”

15.speaker: Karl Greiser
15.text: “I want to make it absolutely clear. My belief in you as a leader is unquestionable.”

17.speaker: Lucian Galade
17.text: “We have been informed of the establishment of the Anti-Corruption Police under the Ministry of Justice.”

18.speaker: Player
18.text: “Focus Anti-Corruption investigations on Hawker and the Old Guard.”

19.speaker: Lucian Galade
19.text: “We have been informed of the establishment of the Community Police under the Ministry of Interior.”

20.speaker: Lucian Galade
20.text: “We have been informed of the establishment of the Secret State Police under the Ministry of Interior.”

21.speaker: Karl Greiser
21.text: “Our current efforts have been successful at containing these gangs. This force will ensure the reduction of crime in neighbourhoods.”

22.speaker: Karl Greiser
22.text: “I want to make it absolutely clear. My belief in you as a leader is unquestionable. Consider me as your inside man.”

23.speaker: Karl Greiser
23.text: “I have been used to being uncomfortable my whole life. I too came from a poor family, Mr. President.”

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: He took a seat and corrected his posture.

25.speaker: Player
25.text: “The economy must be controlled by the state. Lotherberg has too much influence.”

26.speaker: Karl Greiser
26.text: “Hello, Mr. President. Mr. Galade. What a sunny day, isn't it?”

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: The weather outside was beautiful indeed. Clear sky and sunshine made the scenery look lively. I could even hear the sounds of birds chirping from the palace garden.

28.speaker: Player
28.text: “You are right, I need to go out more often nowadays.”

29.speaker: Player
29.text: “The weather isn't of much concern right now.”

30.speaker: Player
30.text: “Good to see you, Karl. How have you been?”

31.speaker: Karl Greiser
31.text: “Good idea. And when you do, the Presidential Guard will be there to protect you, as always.”

32.speaker: Karl Greiser
32.text: “Very good. Thanks to the increased budget at the Interior, we have been combatting a lot of the issues that plagued us.”

34.speaker: Lucian Galade
34.text: “Please have a seat. We don't want you to feel uncomfortable.”

35.speaker: Karl Greiser
35.text: “It's been going okay. We have tackled many security issues but there are still some to go through.”

40.speaker: Karl Greiser
40.text: “But more importantly, the security situation in the country is much more stable, allowing people to return to a normal life.”

45.speaker: Player
45.text: “People like us know the additional steps that need to be climbed to get anywhere in life.”

46.speaker: Player
46.text: “We both did well for ourselves, Karl.”

48.speaker: Karl Greiser
48.text: “I used to work 15 hours a day to bring food back to my sisters. My entire life was been a struggle until I signed up to be a volunteer in the Arvory police force.”

49.speaker: Karl Greiser
49.text: “Indeed, sir. One way or another we took what we deserved, and life has rewarded us for it.”

50.speaker: Karl Greiser
50.text: “They gave me a scholarship to attend the police academy. An opportunity I wouldn't have been able to have, if I didn't work diligently.”

51.speaker: Karl Greiser
51.text: “That allowed me to enter the Arvory Police Force as a patrolman and to meet Ms. Graf, who opened several doors that led me to better places.”

52.speaker: Player
52.text: “You're a good man, Karl. I still owe you for protecting me and my family.”

53.speaker: Player
53.text: “Nothing comes free and easy, that's for sure.”

54.speaker: Player
54.text: “So, are you very close with Mrs. Graf?”

55.speaker: Player
55.text: “So, she's the one who got you this far, eh?”

56.speaker: Karl Greiser
56.text: “I did my job. But beyond that I would easily risk my life to save the President of Sordland.”

58.speaker: Player
58.text: “We can rise even higher if we dare to dream.”

60.speaker: Player
60.text: “Hard-working and loyal people are hard to come by. I need people like you.”

61.speaker: Karl Greiser
61.text: “She played a major role in my life and she still is my superior. But to be honest, my motivations lie with serving the country. And right now that means serving you, sir."

62.speaker: Karl Greiser
62.text: “I'd like to think that it was my own skills and experience, sir. But of course, I cannot deny that she had a huge impact on my career.”

63.speaker: Karl Greiser
63.text: “My loyalties lie with you, Mr. President. No one else.”

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: He didn't sit down and walked a few steps towards the wall where President Alphonso's portrait was hanging.

65.speaker: Karl Greiser
65.text: “Minister Morgna —though not as inspiring as you are— has also shown great capability. The more I work with her, the more I am convinced that she is a very motivated and efficient administrator.”

66.speaker: Player
66.text: “She takes her work personally. Her motivations to fight corruption are real.”

67.speaker: Player
67.text: “So the Anti-Corruption Police is separated from the Interior?”

68.speaker: Player
68.text: “You are our best man for the job and I am sure you will excel at it.”

69.speaker: Karl Greiser
69.text: “Minister Graf —though not as inspiring as you are— has also shown great capability. But the more I work with her, the more I am convinced that she herself might pose a threat to you.”

70.speaker: Karl Greiser
70.text: “The Nargis, Agnland and Bergia regions are suffering from most of the crime issues. Out of all Estord seems to be the hot spot.”

72.speaker: Player
72.text: “The only thing that matters is that you only take orders from me, and not anyone else.”

73.speaker: Player
73.text: “Minister Graf is our close ally in the cabinet. I don't want similar words uttered again.”

74.speaker: Player
74.text: “The gangs are concentrated in that city aren't they?”

75.speaker: Player
75.text: “Lileas Graf has a good security history. You will handle them with her.”

76.speaker: Player
76.text: “If you are successful, a better future awaits you in the administration.”

77.speaker: Karl Greiser
77.text: “Her drive certainly is, but there are real obstacles nonetheless. This new force can help in removing those.”

78.speaker: Karl Greiser
78.text: “Therefore, having the new police force separated from the Interior helps its independence and objectivity.”

79.speaker: Karl Greiser
79.text: “Yes. It is for a good reason. We have found some irregularities in our police forces. Some of our top officers are involved with corruption.”

80.speaker: Karl Greiser
80.text: “Thanks for the good words. You honor me, but our job is not yet done.”

81.speaker: Lucian Galade
81.text: “The Old Guard must have pushed this forward. We shouldn't even consider moving on the reformist leader in our position.”

82.speaker: Lucian Galade
82.text: “Hawker, Heron and their cronies in the Supreme Court won't be able to be prosecuted unless the Assembly agrees to in our new constitution.”

83.speaker: Lucian Galade
83.text: “The Community Police is driven by local enforcement and will aid us in our internal security efforts.”

84.speaker: Karl Greiser
84.text: “There are elements within our state that have ulterior motives.”

85.speaker: Karl Greiser
85.text: “Why would anyone pose a threat? Because of the power they hold, of course. I can easily tell you that she pulls many strings. Ambition is a dangerous thing.”

91.speaker: Karl Greiser
91.text: “Thanks to the resource diversion to her ministry, those objectives can now be met. Justice will indeed be served.”

98.speaker: Karl Greiser
98.text: “There are some very powerful deep state forces inside the administration. Our investigations have just begun, but certain links we have discovered are troubling.”

99.speaker: Karl Greiser
99.text: “I am a supporter of the Emergency Act and the expanded powers given to our police to stabilise the country. We have achieved our goals.”

100.speaker: Lucian Galade
100.text: “We always suspected the existence of such a deep state. The real question here is, who in the government and cabinet is on Mr. Hawker's side?”

101.speaker: Karl Greiser
101.text: “Mr. Hawker has financial and other ties to certain figures. He is a dangerous man. Currently, we are collecting evidence to find out exactly what his network comprises.”

103.speaker: Karl Greiser
103.text: “I couldn't agree more. Anyone who corrupts our system and creates a parallel organization is a threat to Sordland.”

104.speaker: Karl Greiser
104.text: “Thank you, sir. I will be relentless. The adversaries of this country will be found.”

105.speaker: Karl Greiser
105.text: “Yes, she does, despite constantly encountering resistance in the Ministry and other institutions. Morgna is poking around where she isn't wanted."

106.speaker: Lucian Galade
106.text: “Once enough evidence is gathered, we should be able to begin the corruption trials if we want to.”

107.speaker: Karl Greiser
107.text: “Besides them, there are other elements we are aware of. The Oligarchs seem to have some people in the inside as well. We have received some unconfirmed reports about Mr. Tusk having bought people in the administration.”

108.speaker: Player
108.text: “Bribery should be eradicated from the system.”

109.speaker: Player
109.text: “We could look further into Tusk and the Lotherberg group.”

110.speaker: Karl Greiser
110.text: “And they seem to be evading taxes through bribery and exploiting the grey areas in our laws. Our investigators in Estord and Narbel have also found some suspicious financial activity from some of their corporations. If their tax returns were to be made public, it would help us track irregularities in the filings.”

117.speaker: Lucian Galade
117.text: “Hawker, Heron and the rest of the Guard in the Supreme Court will be able to be prosecuted with our new constitution. The President will have full authority to do so.”

118.speaker: Lucian Galade
118.text: “Hawker, Heron and the rest of the Guard in the Supreme Court won't be able to be prosecuted at all.”

119.speaker: Player
119.text: “Don't poke the bear when we are not ready to fight it. Maintain low-key operations.”

120.speaker: Karl Greiser
120.text: “Our police is made up of only the most loyal officers, sir. Hundreds of people, hand-picked by Minister Morgna. They have no history with the establishment.”

121.speaker: Karl Greiser
121.text: “Our operations are very hidden at the moment. We are picking off the weaker cogs in the machine that will eventually lead us to the top."

122.speaker: Lucian Galade
122.text: “It won't be possible to get them if we fail to pass the reforms or we have low political support in the Assembly. But it is too early to tell.”

123.speaker: Lucian Galade
123.text: “This means we can't cut the head off the snake, but we will be able to strangle everyone around them.”

124.speaker: Lucian Galade
124.text: “However, it won't be possible to get them if we fail to pass the reforms. It all depends on whether we can gather support."

128.speaker: Player
128.text: “I don't always see eye to eye with her, but we might be allies on this topic.”

129.speaker: Karl Greiser
129.text: “I think our enemies are common so why not be friends. The bigger picture is about our country after all.”

133.speaker: Player
133.text: “I'm not sure if Morgna can be fully trusted. What if she turns this force against us?”

134.speaker: Karl Greiser
134.text: “That would be unlikely, wouldn't it? You are the person that gave her the cabinet position, allowing her to have the authority to fight the real enemies.”

138.speaker: Karl Greiser
138.text: “Not only that, you diverted funding to her ministry. You are the only President to have done so in the history of the Republic.”

139.speaker: Karl Greiser
139.text: “Mr. President, you founded this force to fight corruption. We will only take down those who are truly deserving of it."

140.speaker: Narrator
140.text: Lucian coughed. I saw Karl gaze at him for a moment.

145.speaker: Lucian Galade
145.text: “The most important subject here is the Old Guard establishment. They pose a direct threat to us.”

152.text: “Tusk is an issue but he shouldn't be our primary target. There are bigger fish to fry.”

153.speaker: Karl Greiser
153.text: “If that is your desire, we can certainly inquire further about their operations.”

154.speaker: Karl Greiser
154.text: “We will do our best, sir. It plagues us from all ends but the Oligarchs seem to have immense influence and money. They keep utilizing it.”

155.speaker: Karl Greiser
155.text: “You are correct, President Rayne. They need to be looked at.”

156.speaker: Karl Greiser
156.text: “Marcel Koronti and HOS also have a strong presence in the media and many other industries. There are some patterns we observed that are unusual.”

158.speaker: Player
158.text: “Mr. Koronti has been very supportive of my administration. He is a close friend.”

159.speaker: Player
159.text: “Marcel offered me a deal before, and needs to be investigated.”

160.speaker: Player
160.text: “Focus Anti-Corruption investigations on Tusk and the Oligarchs.”

161.speaker: Karl Greiser
161.text: “Yes. Minister Graf has given me full authority to lead the new force in order to combat organised crime, drug trade and trafficking in our poorer cities and their neighbourhoods. Their role is of a supportive nature.”

162.speaker: Player
162.text: “We need to protect and keep our communities safe. This is another step towards that.”

163.speaker: Player
163.text: “If communities, especially of ethnic descent, gain more responsibility in their own security, it could backfire.”

164.speaker: Player
164.text: “How did we ever come to this low point?”

165.speaker: Karl Greiser
165.text: “Correct. Minister Graf has given me full authority to lead the new force in order to combat subversives and other threats to the state from the inside. The agents we have recruited are the most loyal and experienced.”

166.speaker: Karl Greiser
166.text: “Indeed so. Minister Morgna has given me full authority to lead the new force in order to fight corruption from within.”

167.speaker: Player
167.text: “It's a very powerful force. One that didn't exist in Sordland before.”

168.speaker: Player
168.text: “The important question for us is where your loyalties lie.”

169.speaker: Player
169.text: “Congratulations. I hope we'll be close partners in the fight against corruption.”

170.speaker: Player
170.text: “There are too many enemies inside Sordland. They need to be found and imprisoned.”

171.speaker: Player
171.text: “The important question for us is where your loyalties lie.”

172.speaker: Player
172.text: “It's a very powerful force. One that didn't exist in Sordland before.”

173.speaker: Karl Greiser
173.text: “Our established forces has begun gathering intelligence on the suspected enemies of the state.”

174.speaker: Karl Greiser
174.text: “I serve my country and its leader President Anton Rayne.”

175.speaker: Karl Greiser
175.text: “Yes. We have great powers regarding our operations, thanks to the Security Package and your authority.”

176.speaker: Karl Greiser
176.text: “The enhanced local security and cooperation these new local forces provide will help us improve the dangerous situation in these neighbourhoods.”

177.speaker: Karl Greiser
177.text: “Harsher police action does not necessarily helps us win the battle against organised crime. We need to work with the locals.”

178.speaker: Karl Greiser
178.text: “The recession has allowed these criminal gangs to take control in poverty-stricken areas. Desperate people will do a lot for money.”

179.speaker: Karl Greiser
179.text: “The structure being separated from the Interior helps maintain perspective and independence from previous hierarchies.”

180.speaker: Karl Greiser
180.text: “I serve my country and its leader President Anton Rayne.”

181.speaker: Karl Greiser
181.text: “Sir, we have a tough and long fight ahead of us. It will take years, but we will win. You can believe that.”

185.speaker: Karl Greiser
185.text: “It's fine, sir. The Emergency Act gave us wide-ranging powers and allowed us to crush any illegal activity in the country.”

186.speaker: Karl Greiser
186.text: “However, I couldn't help but notice that certain high-ranking officers in the Sordish Police Force have been acting autonomously. This is a grave concern for us.”

188.speaker: Player
188.text: “We need to find out about their weaknesses, just in case.”

189.speaker: Player
189.text: “Don't worry about Hawker. He is aiding our administration.”

190.speaker: Karl Greiser
190.text: “Mr. Hawker has financial and other ties to certain figures in the police and the government. He is a dangerous man. Currently, we are collecting evidence of his middlemen to discover a real link that would lead to further suspects.”

191.speaker: Karl Greiser
191.text: “After further research, we found that there are some very powerful deep state forces inside the administration influencing our security. Our investigations have just begun, but certain links we have discovered are troubling.”

193.speaker: Player
193.text: “Good day and good luck, Mr. Greiser.”

195.speaker: Karl Greiser
195.text: “It is a privilege to work with you, President Rayne. Good day.”

196.speaker: Narrator
196.text: Lucian glanced at me with his eyebrow raised.

198.speaker: Karl Greiser
198.text: “In that case, the department will keep an eye on any leads.”

202.speaker: Player
202.text: “Me and Lileas see eye to eye on many issues. I wouldn't worry about her.”

203.speaker: Karl Greiser
203.text: “That won't change sir. I was just trying to give you some inside information from the Interior.”

205.speaker: Karl Greiser
205.text: “She holds immense power in the Interior security apparatus. She also seems to have a powerful base in the party.”

206.speaker: Narrator
206.text: Karl leaned closer and lowered his voice ever so slightly.

207.speaker: Narrator
207.text: Karl leaned closer and lowered his voice ever so slightly.

211.speaker: Karl Greiser
211.text: “There are elements within our state that have ulterior motives.”

217.speaker: Karl Greiser
217.text: “The initial analysis by our agents has uncovered some troubling facts.”

219.speaker: Lucian Galade
219.text: “We surely can to be on the safe side, even though we are working with them.”

223.speaker: Karl Greiser
223.text: “Minister Morgna is very concerned about the Supreme Court and Old Guards. She sees them as the primary threat.”

227.speaker: Karl Greiser
227.text: “I've had many of my trusted officers scout hundreds of loyal community volunteers and train them in the police academies around the country. The Koranelli and Skinner gangs have a presence in many of their districts.”

228.speaker: Karl Greiser
228.text: “We are fighting them already, and the community police force will cut their connections further.”

229.speaker: Player
229.text: “The crime families need to be taken down. We can't let them do what they want with impunity.”

230.speaker: Karl Greiser
230.text: “Of course, sir. We are working in close collaboration with Mrs. Graf. Things are much better already.”

231.speaker: Karl Greiser
231.text: “Yes, they have a lot of presence there. Our efforts are increasingly pushing them to act in the shadows.”

233.speaker: Karl Greiser
233.text: “He might not be innocent, but if you think he isn't an issue then we can move on.”

234.speaker: Karl Greiser
234.text: “They do have reach, but the President has much more influence and authority.”

235.speaker: Karl Greiser
235.text: “We certainly can. I wish we had proof of the incident. It would help in a case against him.”

236.speaker: Karl Greiser
236.text: “Last but not least is the opposition leader Frens Ricter. We have received intelligence that he has connections to Arcasia.”

238.speaker: Karl Greiser
238.text: “It really seems like they have a powerful influence in the majority of the so-called independent news organisations. They might not be so independent after all.”

239.speaker: Lucian Galade
239.text: “It's not good to underestimate such critical public opinion tools.”

240.speaker: Karl Greiser
240.text: “Upon further inquiries, we can't see anything illegal here besides a mismatch of information.”

241.speaker: Player
241.text: “Frens Ricter is our ally and we shouldn't move against him.”

242.speaker: Player
242.text: “There is nothing illegal, so why even talk about this?”

243.speaker: Player
243.text: “Ricter is a loyal servant of Sordland. The Old Guard is trying to pressure him.”

247.speaker: Player
247.text: “He must have some dirt on him. We should look deeper.”

249.speaker: Karl Greiser
249.text: “The way we received this intelligence was unusual, to say the least. It totally came through the back channels.”

250.speaker: Karl Greiser
250.text: “I wanted to disclose all of the information that the ACP has.”

251.speaker: Karl Greiser
251.text: “Everyone has something, usually. The PFJP and the other opposition members can't be fully clean.”

252.speaker: Karl Greiser
252.text: “Therefore, we need to pick a faction to focus on. We can't investigate everyone within the remainder of this term and come up with a thorough and compelling case.”

253.speaker: Lucian Galade
253.text: “There are so many potential corruption cases here.”

254.speaker: Karl Greiser
254.text: “Where should we concentrate our anti-corruption efforts?”

255.speaker: Karl Greiser
255.text: “Yes, sir. We will focus our research and investigation on the Old Guard.”

256.speaker: Karl Greiser
256.text: “Yes, sir. We will focus our research and investigation on the Oligarchs.”

257.speaker: Karl Greiser
257.text: “Yes, sir. We will focus our research and investigation on the PFJP as well as the NFP."

264.speaker: Lucian Galade
264.text: “The Old Guard has us exactly where they want us. If we unleash the ACP on them, we might have a backup in case things don't go well.”

265.speaker: Lucian Galade
265.text: “The most logical step would be to use the ACP to pressure either the Oligarchs or the Old Guard.”

266.speaker: Lucian Galade
266.text: “Well, it has been decided. That should conclude the meeting.”

267.speaker: Karl Greiser
267.text: “I am very glad you have taken such a step, Mr. President. Well... I will continue my work if there is nothing else.”

271.speaker: Player
271.text: “The increased Interior budget should allow us to diminish them.”

272.speaker: Karl Greiser
272.text: “It already has. We are receiving reports of several early successes. Once the Community Police operations kick in with full force, we will end those gangs.”

273.speaker: Karl Greiser
273.text: “You should receive further reports on our progress and actions in the upcoming months, President Rayne.”

274.speaker: Player
274.text: “Make sure the force represents the diverse makeup of the neighborhoods in which it is active.”

275.speaker: Player
275.text: “Make sure to pick the right people for the job and have solid background checks.”

276.speaker: Player
276.text: “Don't arm the Community Police. We shouldn't trust them yet.”

277.speaker: Karl Greiser
277.text: “I also wanted to point out that hundreds of Agno-Sordish, Bludish and Sordish volunteers are now entering training. Soon they will assist our forces.”

278.speaker: Karl Greiser
278.text: “Very well, sir. We will ensure diversity in the new force.”

279.speaker: Karl Greiser
279.text: “We are ensuring that people take charge of their own districts. By giving them responsibility and oversight, we will have them as our allies on the ground.”

280.speaker: Karl Greiser
280.text: “I have personally picked the initial recruits. My officers are evaluating all of them with thorough checks.”

281.speaker: Karl Greiser
281.text: “I understand your perspective. I will remove the right to carry a weapon for the CP.”

282.speaker: Karl Greiser
282.text: “Yes sir. If you think he is an enemy, we will look deeper.”

283.speaker: Player
283.text: “He must have some dirt on him. We might need to look deeper.”

284.speaker: Lucian Galade
284.text: “The Old Guard must have pushed this forward. We should consider investigating Mr. Ricter further. The PFJP poses a threat for the next election. It's better to know more.”

285.speaker: Karl Greiser
285.text: “Upon further inquiries, we see a mismatch of information between the border guard and the intelligence units.”

286.speaker: Karl Greiser
286.text: “The way we received this intelligence was unusual to say the least. It totally went through the back-channels.”

287.speaker: Player
287.text: “Frens Ricter should be investigated in full.”

288.speaker: Player
288.text: “There is nothing illegal, so why even talk about this?”

289.speaker: Player
289.text: “Ricter is a loyal servant of Sordland. Old Guards are trying to pressure him.”

290.speaker: Karl Greiser
290.text: “Let's start with the primary person, the opposition leader Frens Ricter. We have received credible intelligence that he has connections to Arcasia.”

291.speaker: Karl Greiser
291.text: “Everyone has something, usually. The PFJP and the other opposition members can't be fully clean.”

292.speaker: Lucian Galade
292.text: “There are so many potential corruption cases here.”

293.speaker: Karl Greiser
293.text: “I wanted to fully disclose all information available to the SSP.”

294.speaker: Narrator
294.text: Lucian looked deep in thoughts. He sighed before he continued. I saw Karl gaze at him.

295.speaker: Karl Greiser
295.text: “Not only that you also diverted the funding to her ministry. You are the only President to have done so in the history of the Republic.”

296.speaker: Karl Greiser
296.text: “Mr. President you founded this force to fight corruption and it won't be able take those down who are clear of evidence.”

309.text: “We always suspected that they were dangerously close but the real question here is who in the government and cabinet is on their side?”

313.text: “Our agency is made up of the most loyal, sir. Hundreds of people were hand-picked by Minister Graf, personally. They have no history with the establishment.”

314.speaker: Karl Greiser
314.text: “Our operations are very hidden at the moment. We are picking off the weaker cogs in the machine that will eventually lead us to the top.

315.speaker: Player
315.text: “Not sure if Graf can be fully trusted. What if she turns this force against us?”

316.speaker: Karl Greiser
316.text: “That would be unlikely wouldn't it, sir? You are the person that gave her the cabinet position; allowing her to have the authority to fight the real enemies.”

317.speaker: Karl Greiser
317.text: “There are some very powerful deep state forces inside the administration. Our investigations have just begun but certain links we have discovered are troubling.”

318.speaker: Karl Greiser
318.text: “Thank you sir, I will be relentless; the adversaries of this country will be found.”

319.speaker: Karl Greiser
319.text: “I couldn't agree more. Anyone who attacks the state and creates a parallel organisation is a threat to Sordland.”

320.speaker: Player
320.text: “We need to find out who has ulterior motives and root them out of the administration.”

321.speaker: Player
321.text: “Keep pursuing this Karl. If you encounter any obstacles, my full authority will protect you.”

322.speaker: Lucian Galade
322.text: “The most important subject here is the Old Guard establishment. They pose a direct threat to us.”

323.speaker: Lucian Galade
323.text: “Once enough intelligence is gathered, we may be able to arrest them extrajudicially.”

324.speaker: Player
324.text: “Focus Secret State Police investigations on Hawker and the Old Guard.”

325.speaker: Player
325.text: “Focus Secret State Police investigations on Tusk and the Oligarchs.”

326.speaker: Player
326.text: “Focus Secret State Police investigations on the opposition parties.”

327.speaker: Karl Greiser
327.text: “Yes, sir. We will focus our research and investigation on the Oligarchs.”

328.speaker: Karl Greiser
328.text: “Yes, sir. We will focus our research and investigation on the PFJP and the NFP.”

329.speaker: Karl Greiser
329.text: “Yes, sir. We will focus our research and investigation on the Old Guard.”

330.speaker: Karl Greiser
330.text: “He might not be innocent, sir. But if you think he isn't an issue, then we can move on.”

331.speaker: Karl Greiser
331.text: “Very well, sir. If he isn't a big concern for you, we can talk about other figures.”

335.speaker: Karl Greiser
335.text: “If that is your desire, we can certainly inquire further about their operations.”

336.speaker: Karl Greiser
336.text: “We will do our best, sir. It plagues us from all ends, but the Oligarchs seem to have immense influence and money. They keep utilizing it.”

337.speaker: Karl Greiser
337.text: “Marcel Koronti and HOS also have a strong presence in the media and many other industries. There are some patterns we observed that are unusual.”

338.speaker: Karl Greiser
338.text: “We certainly can do so. I wish we had proof of the incident... It would help in a case against him.”

339.speaker: Karl Greiser
339.text: “And it is suspected that they are evading taxes through bribery and exploiting grey areas in our laws. Our investigators in Estord and Narbel have also found some suspicious financial activity from some of their corporations. If tax returns were to be made public, it would help us track irregularities in the filings.”

343.speaker: Karl Greiser
343.text: “Besides them, there are other elements we are aware of. The Oligarchs seem to have some people in the inside as well. We have received some unconfirmed reports about Mr. Tusk having made deals with the enemies of the state.”

345.speaker: Player
345.text: “Mr. Koronti has been very supportive of my administration. He is a close friend.”

346.speaker: Player
346.text: “Marcel offered me a deal before. He needs to be investigated in full.”

347.speaker: Karl Greiser
347.text: “You are correct, President Rayne. They need to be looked at.”

348.speaker: Karl Greiser
348.text: “They do have reach, but the President has much more influence and authority.”

349.speaker: Player
349.text: “Tusk is an issue, but he shouldn't be our primary target. There are bigger fish to fry.”

350.speaker: Karl Greiser
350.text: “It really seems like they have a powerful influence in the majority of the so-called independent news organisations. They might not be so independent after all.”

351.speaker: Player
351.text: “The Oligarchs pose a larger threat to our administration. We need to curb them immediately.”

352.speaker: Player
352.text: “The economy must be controlled by the state. Lotherberg has too much influence.”

353.speaker: Player
353.text: “Bribery should be eradicated from the system.”

354.speaker: Lucian Galade
354.text: “It's not good to underestimate such critical public opinion tools.”

359.speaker: Player
359.text: “We need to find out about their weaknesses, just in case.”

360.speaker: Player
360.text: “Don't worry about Hawker. He is aiding our administration.”

362.speaker: Karl Greiser
362.text: “In that case, the department will keep an eye on any leads.”

363.speaker: Karl Greiser
363.text: “Mr. Hawker has financial and other ties to certain figures in the police and the government. He is a dangerous man. Currently, we are collecting evidence in order to discover exactly what his network comprises.”

364.speaker: Lucian Galade
364.text: “We surely can do that to be on the safe side, even though we are working with them.”

365.speaker: Karl Greiser
365.text: “Minister Morgna is very concerned about the Supreme Court and Old Guard. She sees them as the primary threat.”

366.speaker: Narrator
366.text: Lucian glanced at me with his eyebrow raised.

367.speaker: Karl Greiser
367.text: “I am a supporter of the Emergency Act and the expanded powers given to our police to stabilise the country. We have achieved our goals.”

368.speaker: Karl Greiser
368.text: “After further research, we found that there are some very powerful deep state forces inside the administration influencing our security. Our investigations have just begun, but certain links we have discovered are troubling.”

370.speaker: Karl Greiser
370.text: “However, I couldn't help but notice that certain high-ranking officers in the Sordish Police Force have been acting autonomously. This is a grave concern for us.”

371.speaker: Karl Greiser
371.text: “Therefore we need to pick a faction to focus on. We can't investigate everyone within the remainder of the term and come up with a thorough and compelling case.”

376.speaker: Lucian Galade
376.text: “The Old Guard have us exactly where they want us. If we unleash the SSP on them we might have something as a backup, in case things don't go well.”

377.speaker: Lucian Galade
377.text: “The most logical step would be to use the SSP to pressure either the Oligarchs or the Old Guard.”

378.speaker: Karl Greiser
378.text: “The Reformists are a threat to the next election, sir. The people could rally behind them and endanger your administration. With the SSP, we can resort to harsh but necessary actions to remove these threats.”

379.speaker: Player
379.text: “That's exactly what I want you to do.”
